summary.intent: Execute and merge plan 69-19 (migrate the recycle-bin subsystem from the legacy folder-model to node/v3) as part of retiring legacy folder-model types in CipherBox phase 69.
summary.outcome: Plan 69-19 completed successfully in an isolated worktree, verified green (cargo check, core + fuse tests passing), merged as 9b01eaa68, bringing phase 69 to 17/20 merged; 69-20 launched next in the 69-19 → 69-20 → 69-10 legacy-retirement sequence.

repo: BinEntry (crates/core/src/bin.rs) was reshaped to node/v3 restore data: FilePointer/FolderEntry fully removed, replaced by SealedChildRef (read plane, sealed under parent read key, keyed by ipnsName) and WriteChildRef (write plane, sealed under parent write key, keyed by child UUID) — kept intentionally non-conflated per D-07 security markers.
The delete path derives child_id via uuid_from_ino(child_ino) and calls cipherbox_sdk::build_child_refs(...) to produce both refs from the parent's and child's inode read/write keys.
RecycleBinMetadata is still ECIES-wrapped as a whole under the user key — no node-to-node hop was introduced by this migration.

Building with --features winfsp fails on macOS due to windows-future crate needing windows_core::imp::IMarshal (a platform-crate gap, never reaches project code) — this is expected-red locally and is owned/verified by 69-14 Windows CI, not a regression to chase.
Isolated wave-N worktree executor agents deliberately do NOT update STATE.md/ROADMAP.md — that reconciliation is owned by the execute-phase orchestrator at merge time.

code.finding: BinEntry final shape: id, item_type, name, original_parent_ipns_name, original_path, deleted_at, size, mime_type, content_cid?, content_size?, version_cids?, child_published_node: String, child_ref: SealedChildRef, write_child_ref: WriteChildRef

workflow: Legacy folder-model retirement in phase 69 follows strict sequence: 69-19 (recycle-bin) → 69-20 (vault-creation) → 69-10 (delete legacy types), each required to be workspace-green before the next starts.
Standard loop per plan: launch Agent in a worktree → on task-notification, verify+merge via Bash → track+prune the worktree → fetch base and launch the next plan's Agent.

open_items: 69-20 (vault-creation → node/v3 migration) launched next, then 69-10 (delete legacy folder-model types) after that.
69-14/WinFsp Windows CI verification remains the last item for phase 69 (requires the user's Windows box; winfsp build is expected-red on macOS).

Documented residual E2E risks from 69-19: no live restore command exercised yet, empty child_published_node keeper, generation pinned to 0, WinFsp changes unverified locally (mirrored best-effort only).
